jobs.title: Dance, Theate, Music and Art Teachers
jobs.body:
Davis Parks School of Arts is growing rapidly, with over 500 students enrolled, and we are expanding our team! We are currently hiring for multiple positions, including:
Dance TeachersArt CoordinatorArt TeachersMusic TeachersTheater CoachesWe are looking for positive, reliable, and passionate educators who love working with students and want to be part of a supportive, high-energy arts community.
 
What We Offer:
Competitive payContinuing education opportunities401(k) optionsSupportive team cultureGrowth opportunities within the organizationIf you are passionate about the arts and want to be part of a growing school and strong community, we would love to hear from you.

To Apply:
Send your resume and cover letter to jobs@davisparksarts.com
